channel.title: UEFA Champions League Football
channel.desc: Highlights of the 2026 UEFA Champions League final between Arsenal and PSG in Budapest. Twenty years on from their last appearance in the European Cup final, Arsenal are seeking to win their first Champions League title. However, they face a formidable test in the reigning European champions, Paris Saint-Germain. Jason Mohammad presents, with expert analysis from Nedum Onuoha and Matt Upson. Commentary by Steve Wilson and Chris Sutton.
